note: [L] proves the comparison for every slow-growth label family and every sound section, along an extraction order f (full tails being the case Order.full), with P inside the terminal map. The statement is not restricted to equation labels or to the section of Lemma A-R4, and its hypotheses come from the construction record.

lemma calibrated_field (C : Family G) (R : Weave G) (d N p : ℕ) (o : Site (C.side N p))
    (x : Label G d) : C.O N p (embedTo C R d N p x) o =
    ((C.S.a N:ℂ)^d)⁻¹ • ((C.localSection d).evaluate ((C.labels.level d).coords (R d x)) ∘ expandAt o) := by
